Mason Hart then spent time at the crease without scoring before Lucas Finch bowled him, and at twelve for two Westbrook were already behind the rhythm of a fifty-over innings. Julian Wells gave the reply its first small correction, adding a few firm strokes and reaching double figures, while Oliver Cross, the captain, began the only substantial batting effort of the innings at the other end. Their stand lifted the score into the twenties, but even that phase carried the feeling of repair rather than progress, and when Julian was trapped by Noah Vale, Hillcrest were back into the innings before Westbrook had established anything close to a base.
